description: Call this BEFORE designing or building any user interface (a page, screen, component or flow). Returns the ihumane workflow and the brief: what to find out first, which questions to ask your human (at most 3, each with a default), and which pattern choices you must not make silently. If you pass the task, it also lists the rules most likely to matter. Free: the workflow, the first step and the core rules; the other rules are ihumane Pro and are named by title.

task.description: What you're about to design or build, in a sentence, e.g. 'settings page for a small-team task app, clean and modern'

name: ihumane_ui_start
title: Start a UI design task
